content: Root cause: The bug was caused by improper handling of socket locking during the tear-down process of sockmap and sockhash, which led to sleeping issues within RCU (Read-Copy-Update) critical sections while holding a spinlock. This situation could occur when there was at least one socket present in the map, resulting in broken locking rules and potential race conditions. The patch adds a test to verify these locking rules and ensure that the accompanying fixes address the underlying issue.
